name: Scholar Gateway
description:
Scholar Gateway enables Claude to generate responses grounded in peer-reviewed sources with verifiable citations and DOI links. The Scholar Gateway Connector searches current literature from Wiley journals and research databases to deliver evidence-backed answers with complete source metadata. This enables you to verify that claims are backed with sourced research — ensuring your Claude-assisted research meets professional research standards.

Note: The Scholar Gateway Connector provides access to Wiley content only, additional publisher sources will be added soon. Authentication required, please reach out to Wiley at scholargateway@wiley.com.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Scholar Gateway to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Scholar Gateway to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://connector.scholargateway.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is Scholar Gateway MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 16, 2026, Scholar Gateway scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Scholar Gateway MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Scholar Gateway provides these MCP tools: Semantic Search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Scholar Gateway?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Scholar Gateway in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.

_published_faq.name: Does Scholar Gateway MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Scholar Gateway requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Why is Scholar Gateway failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Scholar Gateway scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is MCP negotiation succeeds (v1/v2). Failed to connect: Authentication required Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Scholar Gateway is developed by John Wiley & Sons Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
